summary: Organizations tune enterprise topologies to their workloads for HA, independent scaling (such as controller API versus execution capacity) or SLAs; first identify bottlenecks in API response, job processing, database performance or EDA event handling with monitoring tools, then scale those components vertically or horizontally.
questions: How do I customize an AAP enterprise topology?
How do I find AAP performance bottlenecks before scaling?
Should I scale the controller API separately from execution?
